meta.title: Metaphysics Charts (Xuanxue)
meta.description: Chinese metaphysics (xuanxue) — twenty-two systems in one plugin: eight chart systems plus fourteen quick references and self-assessments (almanac, solar–lunar conversion, date selection, bone-weight fortune, Xiao Liu Ren, horoscope, numerology, MBTI-style 16-type questionnaire, life-curve, feng shui, name analysis, nine-type TCM body-constitution questionnaire, five-movements-six-qi yearly chart, Taiyi Shenshu with accumulated-year ju, palace, eight gates and Wen Chang). The first screen shows 20 pick-of-the-bunch entries in three groups and folds the rest behind 'N more'; all 22 stay in the flat tab view. Chart systems: BaZi (hidden stems, ten gods, 12 stages, 42 shensha, strength, pattern and useful-god, luck scoring), Zi Wei Dou Shu (49 stars with brightness, four 12-god cycles, 34 patterns, decade and annual/monthly/daily/hourly mutagen), LiuYao, MeiHua YiShu, Da Liu Ren, Qi Men Dun Jia (three ju-selection schools), compatibility charts (BaZi and Zi Wei), and Tarot, plus an ask-driven interpretation layer. Computed locally with networking off by default, exposed as an agent tool with a Web panel.
